c74object.name: bbb.dmx.fixturemap
c74object.digest: Map fixture parameters into one or more DMX universes.
c74object.description: Loads a bbb.dmx patch JSON file, accepts fixture parameter and fixture-aware tracking messages, and outputs 512-channel DMX universe lists. It can output one selected universe or all known universes.

inlets.inlet: Patch loading and fixture parameter input.

outlets.outlet: DMX data. In single-universe mode this is a 512-value list. In all-universe mode this is universe id followed by 512 values.

method.name: read
method.description: Read a bbb.dmx patch JSON file immediately. Relative paths are resolved by Max against the patch/search path.

method.name: readgroups
method.description: Read an optional bbb.dmx groups JSON file. Groups are explicit fixture id arrays validated against the loaded patch.

method.name: readoverrides
method.description: Read an optional bbb.dmx semantic overrides JSON file. Overrides add parameter aliases and profile/mode-specific semantic color/intensity behavior.

method.name: bang
method.description: Output the current DMX frame.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clear the current output frame to defaults.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reload the current patch JSON file.

method.name: reset
method.description: Reset loaded fixture channels to profile defaults.

method.name: bangall
method.description: Output all known universes as universe id followed by 512 DMX values.

method.name: set
method.description: Set one or more normalized 0..1 fixture parameter values. Semantic override aliases are resolved before parameter lookup. Use rawset for raw DMX-domain values.

method.name: setall
method.description: Apply one or more normalized 0..1 parameter/value pairs to every fixture in the loaded patch. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: setgroup
method.description: Apply one or more normalized 0..1 parameter/value pairs to every fixture in a loaded group. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: rawset
method.description: Set one or more raw 8-bit, 16-bit, or 24-bit fixture parameter values. Semantic override aliases are resolved before parameter lookup. Use repeated parameter/value pairs, or parameter pan_tilt with pan and tilt u16 values for paired movement.

method.name: rawsetall
method.description: Apply one or more raw parameter/value pairs to every fixture in the loaded patch. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: rawsetgroup
method.description: Apply one or more raw parameter/value pairs to every fixture in a loaded group. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: nset
method.description: Set one or more normalized 0..1 fixture parameter values.

method.name: nsetall
method.description: Apply one or more normalized 0..1 parameter/value pairs to every fixture in the loaded patch. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: nsetgroup
method.description: Apply one or more normalized 0..1 parameter/value pairs to every fixture in a loaded group. Fixtures that do not expose a requested parameter are silently skipped.

method.name: color
method.description: Set one fixture by semantic RGB color. Semantic override color blocks win over heuristics; otherwise RGB/RGBW/CMY profiles are mapped automatically, using the nearest preceding color-block dimmer when present.

method.name: colorall
method.description: Apply one semantic RGB color to every supported color fixture. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped. Color-block dimmers are mapped when present.

method.name: colorgroup
method.description: Apply one semantic RGB color to every supported color fixture in a loaded group. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped.

method.name: dimmer
method.description: Set one fixture by semantic intensity. Semantic override intensity lists win over heuristics; otherwise all intensity dimmer-like parameters are used.

method.name: dimmerall
method.description: Apply semantic intensity to every supported fixture. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped.

method.name: dimmergroup
method.description: Apply semantic intensity to every supported fixture in a loaded group. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped.

method.name: shutter
method.description: Open or close one fixture by semantic shutter state. Use 1/open/on/true for open and 0/close/closed/off/false/blackout for close. Shutter/strobe shared channels are intentionally overwritten; split GDTF strobe mode channels are reset to no effect for open and close, and close can fall back to dimmer closed.

method.name: shutterall
method.description: Apply one semantic shutter state to every supported fixture. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped. Split GDTF strobe mode channels are reset to no effect for open and close, and close can fall back to dimmer closed.

method.name: shuttergroup
method.description: Apply one semantic shutter state to every supported fixture in a loaded group. Unsupported fixtures are silently skipped. Split GDTF strobe mode channels are reset to no effect for open and close, and close can fall back to dimmer closed.

method.name: track
method.description: Track one mover fixture toward a world-space target using loaded fixture position, rotation, calibration, and profile pan/tilt ranges.

method.name: trackall
method.description: Track every mover fixture toward one world-space target. Non-mover fixtures are skipped unless track_strict is enabled.

method.name: trackgroup
method.description: Track mover fixtures in a loaded group toward one world-space target. Non-mover fixtures are skipped unless track_strict is enabled.

method.name: trackrel
method.description: Track one mover using a vector relative to the fixture origin.

method.name: trackallrel
method.description: Track every mover using the same vector relative to each fixture origin.

method.name: trackgrouprel
method.description: Track mover fixtures in a loaded group using the same vector relative to each fixture origin.

method.name: trackreset
method.description: Clear stored pan-continuity history for one fixture, or for all fixtures when no id is supplied.

method.name: ptbytes
method.description: Patch movertrack pan/tilt byte output into a fixture using that fixture profile's byte order.

method.name: channel
method.description: Set one raw DMX channel in the selected universe.

method.name: channels
method.description: Set repeated raw DMX address/value pairs in the selected universe.

method.name: uchannels
method.description: Set repeated raw DMX universe/address/value triples directly, without changing the selected universe.

attribute.name: patch
attribute.description: Patch JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Attribute loading is deferred; use the read message for immediate explicit loading.

attribute.name: groups
attribute.description: Optional groups JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Groups are explicit fixture id arrays validated against the loaded patch.

attribute.name: group
attribute.description: Alias for groups. Useful for patchers that read better as @group path.json.

attribute.name: semantic_overrides
attribute.description: Optional semantic overrides JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Overrides are validated against matching loaded patch fixtures.

attribute.name: universe
attribute.description: Selected output universe for single-universe output.

attribute.name: universe_mode
attribute.description: Output mode: selected outputs a bare 512-value list; all outputs universe id plus 512 values.

attribute.name: autobang
attribute.description: When non-zero, output automatically after parameter changes.

attribute.name: tracking_mode
attribute.description: Pan continuity mode for track and trackall messages: smart, pan, or off.

attribute.name: default_pan_range
attribute.description: Fallback pan range in degrees when the fixture profile omits pan.range_degrees.

attribute.name: default_tilt_range
attribute.description: Fallback tilt range in degrees when the fixture profile omits tilt.range_degrees.

attribute.name: track_strict
attribute.description: When non-zero, trackall reports non-mover fixtures as errors instead of skipping them.

attribute.name: color_use_white
attribute.description: When non-zero, semantic color extracts RGBW white from min(red, green, blue). When zero, RGBW white is left untouched and RGB channels carry the full color.

attribute.name: color_wheel_fallback
attribute.description: When non-zero, fixtures without RGB/RGBW/CMY use color wheel hue plus dimmer brightness when available.
